body:
Owner: amlink1219. User authorized a three-hour implementation window starting 2026-10-22 17:15 UTC, with correctness prioritized and an independent reviewer.

Implement the local TLM cycle-deepening design on baseline 46804fb3a1c50b29a19a7d0a3da6bb8f8b59af7d. This is a new execution-backend scope, dependent on #95/#96/#104/#107/#110/#112; it does not take ownership of their existing RTL, source models, frozen results or member status files.

Acceptance checklist:
- [x] Freeze source/config/input provenance and preserve legacy v6 regression.
- [x] Explicit integer clocks, latency/II, finite queues/storage, deterministic arbitration, dependencies and backpressure.
- [x] FFN tile chain and Attention query chain with numerical/action conservation and explicit precision/trace provenance.
- [x] Cycle-step reference versus event execution equivalence, adversarial resource/clock/buffer/memory tests.
- [x] Online memory request acceptance/completion boundary, actual-address K/V accounting, selectable RNG contract; no double timing/energy.
- [x] Independent review, reproducible validation and explanatory stall/resource reports.
- [x] Assess framework adapter feasibility and record actually executed versus deferred ONNXim/PyTorchSim/RTL/full-model stages.
- [x] Publish scoped task branch/PR, STATUS and HANDOFF with remaining limitations.

Non-goals for unsupported completion claims: no inherited PPL for changed numeric interfaces; no claim of STA, physical CDC, full silicon PPA, or framework execution without actual evidence. No automatic merge. Existing 40/52-case evidence remains immutable.
Base-backend delivery (2026-10-23): PR126 is open and unmerged. Fixed scientific release ddd2e3406caac5075689f9388a041603e17d2b19; all 438 changed Git objects and 8 selected raw blobs verified remotely. 68 real cropped Qwen cases + 8 synthetic smoke passed; 71 implementation, 54 independent, 43 legacy tests. Independent artifact review covered 302 artifacts, 34 full traces/98,340 operations and 4,597 actual-read payload hashes. The first failed matrix and the finite-prefetch deadlock repair are preserved.

These checkboxes describe the bounded backend deliverable above, not completion of the entire A-G roadmap. Real full-dimensional GQA layers, full-model/PPL, online DRAM command simulation, global physical storage/RNG and PPA remain open. A bounded GQA shared-K/V extension is being implemented/reviewed during the remaining authorized time; full FFN integration continues separately in #123/PR125. Projects sync is pending because the verified token lacks read:project; no permission changes attempted.
